title: Netflix JavaScript Talks - Async JavaScript with Reactive Extensions
summary: A Netflix JavaScript talk on using Reactive Extensions (Rx) for asynchronous UI code. It covers Observables, composing events such as drag and drop, and sequencing Ajax requests.
why: Recommended as a clear, mind-changing introduction to observables and async programming from engineers using Rx in production.

quote.text: have a look at this presentation about Observables at Netflix as it's quite mind changing
